title: Cruleram - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Cruleram in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Cruleram is a ice-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Defense (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Cruleram Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (B), Luck (C). A dedicated ice pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
